messages.subject: batchfiles 0.7 beta
messages.body_plain:
There has been a reworking of the batch files for upcoming version 0.7 . The new files are:
R.bat <https://batchfiles.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/R.bat> - configuration free way to run R. Try. R.bat help for concise help and examples
Rpathset.bat <https://batchfiles.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/Rpathset.bat> - unlike  R.bat, which is configuration free this, is manually set up through SET statements.
batchfiles.md <https://batchfiles.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/batchfiles.md> - detailed documenation. Can read it as is or use pandoc batchfiles.md -o batchfiles.pdf to get a pdf version.
batchfiles is a collection of Windows .bat, .js and .hta files used for running R under Windows.  They are each self contained and independent of each other. Just place any on your Windows path to use it.  See http://batchfiles.googlecode.com

Feedback can be reported to this discussion group.
